records.question: Retrieve exact Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 scene/granule IDs for each listed target/date pair and generate redistributable crops from the original open data.
records.why_open: This environment can identify public archives and date/location recipes but cannot download the provider archives directly.
records.stop_condition: Scene IDs, acquisition timestamps, cloud cover and checksum/source metadata captured for each target.

records.question: Geolocate the exact Bellingcat Valiasr damage area from open Sentinel/OSM rather than pinning a generic barracks name.
records.why_open: No sufficiently trustworthy exact coordinate found in targeted audit.
records.stop_condition: Independent geolocation matches pre/post imagery and map features.

records.question: Locate an archived IRIB/state-TV video/transcript, if it exists, in which an identifiable Iranian official explicitly says Iran fired first or broke the April ceasefire first.
records.why_open: Targeted audit found state-broadcaster confirmation of launches and IRGC retaliation statements, but not the claimed exact admission/interview.
records.stop_condition: Primary video/transcript with timestamp, speaker, original-language phrase and independent translation.
records.description: Current analytical disposition is UNSUBSTANTIATED; recovering the primary clip could change that assessment.

records.topic: Camp Buehring F-5 mission independent corroboration
records.question: Determine whether independent radar, imagery, debris, base BDA or U.S./Kuwaiti after-action evidence confirms the Iranian F-5 strike details beyond the pilots’ later state-TV account.
records.why_open: CENTCOM confirms active combat involving Iranian aircraft but not all mission details or claimed causal mechanism for friendly fire.
records.stop_condition: Independent evidence identifies aircraft, route/attack or effects.
records.description: Current claim that the three Camp Buehring mission pilots were killed is CONTRADICTED by their later appearance alive; independent mission corroboration remains useful for attribution, not casualty status.

records.question: Find independent documentary or imagery evidence for alleged 10-21 IRGC personnel, missile/drone components and gold on July 13 Mahan flight.
records.why_open: Reuters has strong multisource reporting but Iran/Houthi deny the military cargo/personnel.
records.stop_condition: Manifest, imagery, named passenger confirmation, cargo records or multiple independent non-derived sources.

records.question: Run the user-specified one-calendar-day-at-a-time Iranian-source corpus audit from 2026-02-28 through collection date; current add-on contains prioritized high-value chains, not a representation that every daily claim has been captured.
records.why_open: Targeted add-on deliberately did not redo the full OSINT collection.
records.stop_condition: Every day checked across required Iranian source corpus; material claim IDs assigned or explicit no-material-claim marker.

records.question: Obtain archived snapshots and explicit timezone metadata for state/semi-official pages where only publisher display times are currently available.
records.why_open: No fake conversion from a display clock to UTC/local without a documented timezone.
records.stop_condition: Archive URL + original publication/update timestamp + timezone provenance captured.

records.question: Build aircraft/UAV serial-by-serial ledger against 82→130→170→210 Iranian aggregate claims; detect duplicates and separate airborne shootdowns, ground destruction, hits, and targeted-only records.
records.why_open: Iran genuinely caused significant UAV losses, so blanket debunking would be analytically wrong.
records.stop_condition: Every claimed aggregate decomposed into itemized confirmed/probable/unverified rows with duplication controls.

records.question: Resolve six-boat destruction claim using CENTCOM imagery/video, satellite imagery, hull IDs, Iranian pre/post ORBAT and later unit appearances.
records.why_open: Current evidence is U.S. claim versus Iranian denial.
records.stop_condition: At least vessel/hull-level physical evidence sufficient to confirm, contradict, or narrow each loss.

records.question: Identify the destroyer/refueling vessel claimed hit on March 4, reconstruct tracks and post-event condition.
records.why_open: Official IRGC claim is distinct from demonstrably recycled RIMPAC proof video.
records.stop_condition: Target identity/location and post-event condition established from primary/independent evidence.

records.question: Search Iranian official/state-media record March 26-30 for an explicit denial of Tangsiri death before Iranian confirmation.
records.why_open: A four-day confirmation lag alone is not evidence of lying.
records.stop_condition: Explicit denial found and archived, or day-by-day source sweep documented with no denial located.

records.question: Seek independent wreckage, serial, imagery, ISR/BDA-platform flight track, and exact local-site chronology for May 28-29 Bushehr/Jam claim.
records.why_open: CENTCOM denial conflicts with Iranian reporting, while unrelated real MQ-9 losses make date/location precision essential.
records.stop_condition: Specific platform and loss/no-loss outcome resolved independently.

records.topic: Facility claim-origin and exact equipment audit
records.question: For Al Minhad, Ali Al Salem, Fifth Fleet/Bahrain, Al Udeid and other base claims, pair earliest exact Iranian proposition with satellite/equipment-level BDA.
records.why_open: Real base damage does not automatically validate exact equipment or mission-kill assertions.
records.stop_condition: Each claim split into hit/equipment/damage/mission-kill/whole-site propositions and geolocated where possible.

records.question: Determine whether false/recycled/AI media artifacts were posted or endorsed by official Iranian entities versus only propagated by unaffiliated accounts.
records.why_open: Do not impute anonymous social propaganda to IRGC/state institutions.
records.stop_condition: Original uploader/provenance chain archived or official-origin field remains false/unknown.
